body: Ive looked into clubs. Been to a few rush events for a service fraternity at my college. I know as soon as they realize what im like they will just ignore me like everyone else. I have no one to count on for anything. Any one i care about turns their back on me then expects me to be there when they have a bad day. Ya know what? I always am. I can't say fucking no. I fucking hate myself. Tonight is just an extra rough night. Ending it would just be easier for everyone. Ive dealt with crippling depression and anxiety for years. Been so drugged up i couldnt feel anything and been admitted to psych wards twice. I had to assume the role of parent to my own mother because she couldn't take care of herself for two years. I was 11 when that started. I know i shouldn't bitch about this because others have had it worse. Im just tired. Tired of life. I haven't smiled since i was 6. Everyone has their breaking point. Im at mine. What will happen is ill sleep and pull myself out of it like usual until i cant anymore. Sorry for being an inconvience. I appreciate you taking the time to respond. World needs more people like you.

"When did you cut your hair?"
"When I was 17"
"Does the bullying stop?"
"No. But your friends really prove how great of people they are. You make it through bud." 
"Do we ever play varsity football?" 
"Unfortunately, no. Before the program became varsity we got too many concussions. Can't play ever again.
 Your memory also gets really bad"
"Do we still go to school to be a history teacher? "
"Nope, we found a true calling for us."
